items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...one with Stan and Woody and this band. ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, that was about it. ... [INTERVIEWER] ...Woody was not a hell of a good player either, but-- [INTERVIEWEE] No, he isn't.

ctx.x: Everybody was trying to make something significant, they were trying to make symphony out of jazz or make serious music out of jazz or whatever nomenclature applies, and Dorsey asked Stravinsky to write something for him, as I remember.
